capabilities: Trigger actions when a note is accessed, opened, closed, or left
Set note properties with dynamic variables like {{date}}, {{time}}, {{increment}} and {{title}}
Execute any command from the command palette on visibility events
Target notes by tag, folder, exact title, or regular expression, including negative and combined conditions
extras: Beta versions can be tested through BRAT; installation also possible via community plugins or manual file placement.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to react automatically to opening or leaving a note, such as counting views or capturing modification timestamps.
summary: Automation plugin that sets note properties or runs commands when notes are opened, accessed, or left.
